opening.argument: The video presents mining packages as a route to increasing OneCoin’s market price, tying value directly to collective recruitment. It states, “The more people who start mining the one coin The higher the price of the coin in the market,” then identifies the mechanism: “We do that by attracting new miners into the business.” The appeal is operational and promotional, urging viewers to “really bring the packages inside the business” and to “start building your networks properly educate your people.” This is an offer built around paid participation and network expansion, reinforced by repeated OneCoin and Forbes imagery rather than presented as detached reporting or criticism.
